# Radiance Med Spa

> Physician-overseen medical spa in Chambersburg, PA offering injectables, laser and RF treatments, facials, IV therapy, weight loss, and medical-grade skincare.

Radiance Med Spa provides medically supervised aesthetic care with an emphasis on natural, refined results. Treatments are delivered by licensed providers under physician oversight.

## Contact & Location

- Address: 154 Franklin Farm Lane, Chambersburg, PA 17202
- Phone: (717) 423-1799
- Email: contact@radiancepa.com
- Website: https://radiancepa.com
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Radiance+Med+Spa+Chambersburg+PA
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/radiancepa
- Facebook: https://m.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61584037294695

## Booking & Availability

- By appointment only.
- Treatments other than neurotoxin and dermal filler are unavailable until renovation is complete in November/December 2026.
- A provider consultation ($50, fully credited toward any service booked at or after the visit) is required prior to any treatment.

# Treatments & Pricing

## Injectables

### Consultation
- Provider Consultation: $50 — $50 fully credited toward any service booked at or after your visit

### Neurotoxin
- Botox — Per Unit: $14 / unit — Priced per unit; units vary by area and individual
- Jeuveau — Per Unit: $12 / unit — Priced per unit; units vary by area and individual
- Dysport — Per Unit: $5 / unit — Requires more units than Botox; comparable results

### Dermal Filler
- Dermal Filler: Starting at $550 / syringe — Pricing varies by product and volume
- Lips — Typical: 1–2 syringes
- Cheeks / Midface — Typical: 2–4 syringes
- Jawline / Chin — Typical: 2–4 syringes
- Nasolabial Folds / Marionette Lines — Typical: 1–2 syringes
- Tear Trough / Under Eye — Typical: 1–2 syringes; highly technical area

### Biostimulators
- Sculptra: $900 / vial — Per vial; most protocols use 2–4 vials over 2–3 sessions
- Radiesse: $900 / syringe — Per syringe; face or hands
- Hyperdilute Radiesse: $800 / syringe — Diluted for skin tightening & collagen stimulation; neck, décolleté, arms, knees

### Other Injectables
- Kybella — Double Chin: $650 / vial — Per vial; most clients need 2–4 sessions of 1–3 vials
- Hyaluronidase: $300 / vial — Enzyme that dissolves unwanted or misplaced hyaluronic acid filler — per vial; most clients need 2+ vials

Notes: A provider consultation is required prior to any treatment. All injectable pricing is per unit or per syringe/vial as noted. Unit totals vary based on individual anatomy, treatment area, and desired outcome and will be determined during your consultation.

Notes: A provider consultation is required prior to any treatment. Most device and laser treatments require multiple sessions for optimal results; your provider will build a personalized plan during your consultation.

- Sensi Peel: $135–$150 — Our gentlest peel; a good introduction for sensitive skin.
- Ultra Peel: $145–$165 — A slightly stronger peel for mature or photodamaged skin.
- Pigment Correct Peel: $160–$185 — Targeted correction for visible discoloration and uneven tone.
- Bright & Even Peel: $160–$185 — A brightening treatment for more even-looking skin.
- NoPeel Peel: $110 — A no-downtime option.
- OxyTrio — Steps 1–3: $135 — Choice of three masks.
- Advanced Treatment Booster: +$30–$45 — Available as an add-on to customize your treatment.

Notes: A provider consultation is required prior to any treatment, including your first peel service. VIP discounts apply to all facial and peel services. Results may vary based on individual skin type and condition.
